WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS mean_per_day_rate
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_length,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate - mr.mean_per_day_rate AS avg_excess_per_day_rate
FROM rating_stats AS rs
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE rs.avg_per_day_rate > mr.mean_per_day_rate
